title: Team install paths
wanted_capability: Teams referenced by ensemble actors (`contradiction-specialists`, `auto-edge-classifiers`) need a first-class install path — either add `team` to the F4 artifact catalog or ship an `install-teams.sh` bootstrap.
notes: `contradiction-specialists` and `auto-edge-classifiers` teams referenced by ensemble actors but no automated install. Either F4 catalog grows team artifact kind OR install-teams.sh script.
resolution_note: Both asks had already materialized when re-verified (ArtifactKind::Team exists in the F4 catalog; install-teams.sh exists), but the catalog path was a stored-only trap — fixed by gap-37a280a6's instantiate-at-install (same commit). contradiction-specialists now ships as a first-class team artifact (system-defaults/agentic-corpus/teams/). Honest residue, now documented in agentic-corpus-defaults.md: auto-edge-classifiers' membership was never designed in-repo (no brofiles, no teamplate, not instantiated on the live daemon) — auto-edge-arc remains unadoptable until its panel is authored; that residue belongs to the ensemble live-proof scope (gap-9d0f9159), not to install plumbing.
